themes.name: Teamsters strikes raise labor costs
themes.description: Ongoing Teamsters strikes at IKEA, Transdev, Breakthru Beverage and Encore Boston Harbor will raise labor costs and compress margins for those operators.

evidence.headline: ENCORE BOSTON HARBOR TEAMSTERS OVERWHELMINGLY AUTHORIZE STRIKE
NEVADA TEAMSTERS LAUNCH STRIKE AT TRANSDEV
BREAKTHRU BEVERAGE TEAMSTERS WIN STRIKE
IKEA TEAMSTERS FORCED TO STRIKE

narrative.thesis: Ongoing Teamsters strikes across IKEA, Transdev, Breakthru Beverage and Encore Boston Harbor will raise those firms' labor costs and compress their profit margins.
narrative.why_now: Encore Boston Harbor Teamsters overwhelmingly authorized a strike on 2026-08-21, extending the strike wave to a fourth firm.
mechanism_steps: Teamsters strikes halt or disrupt normal operations at targeted firms
Firms face lost output plus higher wages/contingent labor to cover or settle stoppages
Labor cost ratio rises and operating margins compress for the affected operators
narrative.falsifier: Strikes end immediately with no wage concessions and affected firms report unchanged or lower labor-cost ratios

reasons: A validator tied the thesis, why-now, mechanism and falsifier to one evidence core.
1 supporting evidence row reinforced the thesis in the last 24 hours.
4 distinct, supported-source rows carry the same narrative core.
4 of 4 distinct evidence rows repeat at least 2 narrative anchors.
blockers: Needs at least one ticker-linked expression with a causal mechanism and supporting evidence; listing and liquidity are checked later.
